title: As AI gets cheaper, where do the rules apply?
description: Gemini 4 Neon and Microsoft’s MAI models compete on cost per task. NVIDIA halts licensed H200 shipments to China, and banks clarify liability for AI agents.

gemini4-neon.verification_scope: Release announcement on positioning, pricing, availability, reported evaluations and safeguards.

mai-seven-models.date_note: November 17 announcement, included under the 48-hour catch-up window
mai-seven-models.verification_scope: Release announcement on the model lineup, price comparison, tuning scope and MAI Licensed Weights.

nvidia-h200-china.verification_scope: The Verge report on the earnings call and NVIDIA’s fiscal third-quarter results and fourth-quarter outlook.

genie4-project.verification_scope: Release announcement on eligibility, the Genie 4 and Genie 3 updates, the agent and the gallery.

external-agent-sandbox.verification_scope: Willison’s linked post. The longer Prime Radiant article was outside the source review.

banks-ai-agent-liability.verification_scope: Reporting on Citi’s terms and response, other banks’ policies and Anthropic’s read-only finance tools.

disney-anzellans.verification_scope: The Verge’s full report. Disney’s original announcement was outside the source review.

student-help-seeking.verification_scope: Sections 4.1–4.3, 5.1–5.4, 6 and 7, and Table 2 on the sample, exercise, coding, regression and limitations.

ng-verifiable-judgment.verification_scope: Concourse’s auto-captioned segments at 00:09:04–00:11:14 and 00:32:08–00:34:16. No original-audio review. Background from andrewng.org.

rumble2-flash.verification_scope: Release post on the license, architecture, distillation and reported tests. No local run or model-card review.
